title: 猫头鹰的眼睛不会转 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen lines with thin transparent watercolour washes laid loosely over them, warm brown, indigo and pale gold

pages.scene: One single owl perched upright on a bare branch, seen from the front, two large round eyes facing forward, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
One single short bare tree branch with no leaves on it, lying level. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single field mouse standing on all four feet, seen from the side facing left, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single neck bone, a small block of bone with a hole through the middle, seen from the side. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
